name: Nawa o
description: Pepe sitting on the grass looking drained, caption 'Nawa o'. Heavier 'this one don tire me' than standing na_wa.
whenToUse: When the wahala is extra: long story, repeated problem, 'I am tired of this', floor-sitting disbelief. Stronger / more exhausted than na_wa. Use after something ridiculous that knocked the energy out.
whenNotToUse: Not a greeting. Skip light jokes (use chai/na_wa) and anything that needs action instead of sighing.
